Runtime libraries that are not committed. `sh scripts/fetch-deps.sh` downloads them:

- `sdl-webos/libSDL2-2.0.so.0`: SDL2 2.30.12 for webOS ([webosbrew/SDL-webOS](https://github.com/webosbrew/SDL-webOS), zlib license), bundled into the IPK.
- `sdl-windows/SDL2.dll`: SDL2 2.32.10 for the desktop preview ([libsdl-org/SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL)).
